proposition: The dissertation says the Sharḥ al-Basmala was completed before 28 Shaʿbān 829/5 July 1426 (asterisked), was sent to Qāżīzāda Rūmī, carries a marginal dedication to Ulugh Beg, and is unpublished. New Brethren says its dedicatory preface (c. 1426) fashions Ulugh Beg the ultimate philosopher-king and claims the Samarkand Observatory as a realisation of the New Brethren's project; the Sensorium says it explicitly styles him a Pythagorean-Platonic philosopher-king six years after the Mafāḥiṣ. The content of the preface is a claim beyond the dissertation pages read.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, The New Brethren of Purity
